shots.title: 폭풍전야의 대치
shots.prompt:
Black ink brush animation on pale aged Korean hanji. Paper yellowing is the only warm color. No colored pigment. Crisp tapered brush lines and clean black masses, sharp hands, blade contours and hat brim; restrained gray washes, minimal trailing-edge dry brush. Subtle stable paper fibers, no crawling grain, no fuzzy ink spreading, no heavy motion blur, no glossy CGI. Same original bridge and reed riverbank. No text, no dialogue, no singing or added music.

The original Korean swordsman wears a broad low woven satgat firmly tied by its chin cord, hiding eyes and nose in shadow. Frayed dark dopo, cloth belt, one plain single-edged sword with scabbard fixed at left hip. No second sword. The opponent wears the same heavy dark lamellar armor and helmet with cheek guards, holding one sword. The opponent's face and reactions may be visible; never reveal the hero's eyes. Maintain anatomy, hat and weapon design across shots.

Begin from the supplied wide bridge confrontation. Neither fighter advances. The sword stays sheathed. Only a very small movement of reeds, cloth and breathing. Fixed camera, no zoom, preserve the empty distance. Hold the tension throughout.

Single continuous shot. No added background music, speech, subtitles or text. Preserve paper grain without flicker.
